releaseNotes:
Fixed Android app closure with double-buffered alternating Bitmaps and full BackHandler support.
Reduced allocation churn and garbage-collection pressure through zero-allocation ByteArrayPool reuse.
Release package is signed with official 4096-bit RSA certificate and verified checksums.
Added strict certificate verification and package integrity checks to in-app updater.
Hardened host security with 3-attempt PIN lockout, constant-time token comparison, and capability enforcement.
Real-time relative release timing badges and honest protocol labeling.
